artifact_review: The Router found no artifacts. The Perceptual Quality Auditor also found no graphics-level distortions. This suggests the segmentation model struggled with the complex, repetitive topology of the chain, which is often a sign of subtle structural ambiguity in AI generations. While no catastrophic melting is visible to the naked eye in the high-contrast B&W image, the low mask confidence (0.8376) and fragmented mask hint at potential boundary issues that are hard to see. I will not penalize heavily for this as it could be due to the low contrast of the B&W conversion affecting SAM, but it prevents a perfect artifact score. There is no evidence of 'fusion' or 'impossible geometry' in the visible links.
alignment_reasoning: The fine-grained classifier strongly confirms the class 'chain' (logit 7.68 vs 3.07 for next best). The fragmented SAM mask and moderate confidence score suggest some boundary ambiguity, likely due to the repetitive pattern and shallow depth of field, preventing a perfect 5.0 artifact score.
